notes.title: GOOD NEWS!
notes.notes:
📣 INCARNA R•AI•D had been nominated in the world reknown LAVAL VIRTUAL AWARDS in the [b]VR/AR for Entertainment and Media category![/b] 

Being nominated represents a great joy since it shows the recognition of the INCARNA R•AI•D's quality!😁

It is the whole Incarna universe that is being recognized since our game INCARNA ADVENTURES([url=https://www.incarna-studios.com/incarna-adventures-vr-escape-game/]our website[/url]) designed for LBE has been nominated for the AIXR Awards 2021 for the [b]Out-of-Home VR Entertainment of the Year's category[/b][url=https://vrawards.aixr.org/finalists-2021/](follow up here)[/url]!🎉

In honor of those nominations, INCARNA R•AI•D will be off 50% from 23/08/2021 to 29/08/2021🎉

notes.title: [Update]: Incarna RAID V1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hi explorers ! 

Here’s the 1.1.1 ! Ready for adventure? With this new version, try to face the RAID threats in record time and win the "speed of sound" achievement.

New features:

* added the "time trial" leaderboard and its special achievement

* added the “options” menu

* added "Graphics level" feature

* added "Current objective" feature

* added sub-puzzles for Annex 3

Others :

* tweaks and minor bug fixes


     Cheers !

Incarna Studios

notes.title: BEST VR GAME AWARD WINNER!🎉
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're so proud that "[b]INCARNA R•AI•D[/b]" won the Best VR Game Award during the [b]#ETRawards2021[/b], celebrating VR games from french-speaking studios! 😁🎉🎉

We are so excited and grateful for all of you who have voted and gave support! 

On this occasion, we wanted to offer a discount of [b]25%[/b] for one week from today onwards to 10/05/2021!

We hope that you will enjoy it and[b] stay tuned for more news[/b]! 😉
